summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for contact settings, regulasi rename/mappings, login/footer/help UI, responsive widths, and draft CRUD flows for regulasi/kuis. Backend contract tests passed (10/10, sequential run). UI validated protocol-based contact links, /ketentuan query preservation to /regulasi, and draft create-edit-delete flows.

integration_issues.issue: Canvas visible and interactive toggle/reset works, but direct pixel-read check returned false (WebGL readback inconclusive in automation run).

action_items: Optional: strengthen automated 3D rendering assertion strategy (e.g., delayed frame sampling or scene checksum) if strict nonblank proof is required in CI.
Auth playbook alignment check: backend currently uses token body/session storage flow and CORS allow_credentials=false with wildcard origin; confirm if this is intended policy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sets CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=False while auth playbook expects credentialed CORS with explicit origins.
Login response does not set an app auth cookie (observed Set-Cookie only from edge/CDN), so httpOnly app-cookie expectation from optional playbook is not met.
Parallel pytest execution can cause transient 401 in contact settings test when admin password-rotation test runs concurrently; sequential run (-n 1) is stable.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used real accounts (admin/supervisor/karyawan/direksi with bpdjaya3x). CAPTCHA handled via real endpoint + seeded answer hash in test DB for API automation.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ prefixed regulasi/kuis drafts via UI. Contact setting temporarily changed for protocol checks, then restored to contact_label='Hubungi administrator SISDUR.' and contact_url=''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key validated states: /api/settings/contact allowlist only; /settings admin-only + validation; /ketentuan?q&status -> /regulasi preserves query in SPA; notifications/audit mapping returns Regulasi labels; seeded sample active counts remain docs=8, quizzes=6. If running full backend tests with xdist parallelism, expect possible transient auth race due admin password-change regression test.
rca of the issue: Observed transient backend test failure (401 on admin PUT /settings) only during parallel run. RCA: test_api_regression rotates admin password temporarily, invalidating sessions while contact-settings test simultaneously reuses admin auth flow. Mitigation: run these auth-mutating suites serially (-n 1) or isolate with non-overlapping accounts/fixtures.
